name: Takachiho Koheki Co.,Ltd.
summary: Takachiho Koheki Co.,Ltd. operates as a technology trading company in Japan, Asia, and internationally. It offers mechanical component products, including slide rails, cable guides, conston springs, dampers, gas springs, lifting and cylinder lock systems, monitor arms, and other mechanical components; and semiconductor products, such as communication devices, power modules and devices, sensors, connectors, trans, coils, and GPU boards.
